prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Vehicles That Fly; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: Factual daylight aircraft views with no recurring children. Plane: plain white twin-engine passenger jet with teal tail, fixed wings and both engine nacelles under wings. Helicopter: orange civilian craft with a four-blade main rotor, enclosed cabin, tail rotor and two skids. Balloon: broad yellow fabric envelope with three blue vertical panels, dark burner frame, tan basket and one adult pilot wearing a plain gray jacket. Keep aircraft types distinct; safe separated flight areas; no flags, brands or military details.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): White passenger jet with teal tail; Orange four-blade helicopter; Yellow-and-blue hot-air balloon with burner and tan basket
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 5. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): The balloon has no wings. A burner heats the air inside its large fabric bag.
Required illustration: Low angle near yellow-blue balloon during inflation, with envelope upright and full. One adult pilot stands in basket, hand at burner control; contained burner flame points upward through open mouth into envelope, not toward fabric wall. No wings or engine propellers.
Exact current state: Burner adds heat; envelope full, basket still just above ground.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
Framing clarification: Keep every entire aircraft/car and its required teaching parts completely within the inner 84 percent of the canvas, leaving at least 8 percent clear background margin on ALL sides. Nothing essential touches or approaches the picture edge.

visualReview.note: Pilot controls the contained burner beneath the balloon mouth; complete basket and envelope. Producer independently inspected the final installed WebP natively; complete final sequence and relevant native diagrams were independently reviewed.
